3) TALK TO YOUR PROFESSORS! get to know who is teaching you!! TRUST ME WHEN I SAY PROFESSORS PAY ATTENTION TO STUDENTS! they know who will take things seriously & who will not! get to know them! show that you are serious and that you really want this they’ll be willing to help!

4) DONT PROCRASTINATE! okay, now i don’t follow this tip like i should 😂 but it’s VERY easy to get behind in these classes! especially once clinical starts & you’re busy doing careplans for multiple patients ALONG with regular class work for 2 classes! STAY ON TOP OF YOUR WORK!

6) DONT BE AFRAID OF FAILURE! you WILL fail sometimes in nursing school 🤷🏾‍♀️ that’s just the honest truth! i had to repeat an ENTIRE CLASS. you just have to learn from your mistakes & move forward! don’t be stuck on failures! because you are more than that failure!

9) GET THE MOST OUT OF CLINICAL! even though you won’t be in the hospital the first semester, during the semesters after that, really get involved in clinical! you learn more in the hospital than what you do in class y’all, i promise! don’t be nervous! you’ll be okay!

10) LASTLY, ENJOY THE EXPERIENCE. yes, it will be stressful! yes, you will cry! yes, you will want to give up! but nursing school is more than that! you’ll created beautiful bonds with so many people. the time goes by so quickly! you’ll miss it when it’s over! ENJOY IT!

**IM HERE TO HELP! y’all, i am not shy 😂 i talk to anybody and everybody! if you need help, you can come to me! i’ll help in anyway i can! i’m entering my senior year in nursing school! even though i may not have all the answers, i’m sure i can lead you to someone who does!
